settings.heading: WOVEN FOR THE FUTURE: ENERGY EFFICIENCY IN EVERY THREAD

settings.text:
WOVEN FOR THE FUTURE: ENERGY EFFICIENCY IN EVERY THREADOur company's journey towards being energy efficient kicks of at the very start of our manufacturing process. Our all rugs are hand weaven and aesthetic both at same time. We have prohabited the use of machineries in major manufacturing processes, resulting in less waste and a smaller carbon footprint.

We have been using renewable energy sources like solar panel and green building design which minimize our dependency on fossil fuels and reduces our overall energy usage. Our motive of being energy efficient doesn't just limits till factory level. We specifically track record of our transportation network to reduce fuel consumption and emissions during delivery. We comprehend that we can't make a company energy efficient on basis of what happens within a company-it's also about the practices of our suppliers. We join forces with partners who contributes to our commitment to sustainable energy use.

At Indian Rug Store, we understand that being energy efficient is our responsibilty rather than a goal our motive for us. Making thoughtful decisions at each and every stage of production makes us strive to contribute to a cleaner, greener, brighter, and more sustainable future. Our each rug is crafted with precision keeping the thought of protecting the planet in mind.

We proudly offer rugs which contributes in your home's and planet's beauty and sustainability both at same time, ensuring that every thread is woven keeping the thought of future generations in mind. By choosing Indian Rug Store, you are not only offering your home a beautiful and luxurious rug but also a brighter and more energy-efficient world for future generation.

settings.title: GREEN DISTRIBUTION CENTERS
settings.text: We're lessening the effect that our operations have on the environment. To show leadership in environmental efficiency, we launched the Green Building Initiative.

settings.title: WOVEN FOR A GREENER TOMORROW
settings.text: In order to lessen our carbon footprint and support a sustainable future, we incorporate energy efficiency into every aspect of our operations.

settings.title: EFFICIENT THREADS, BETTER PLANET
settings.text: Our commitment to using energy-efficient production methods ensures that every article of apparel helps create a cleaner, more sustainable environment.
